claims.claim: CONTINUE now performs the safe stale-behind synchronization boundary before parsing any existing TASK or reducing Unified State, then re-enters synchronized code exactly once when kernel or TASK state changes.

The boundary is a no-op for equal or non-behind valid candidates, preserves ahead/diverged/dirty/detached/non-main state without destructive integration, and leaves missing or invalid unrefreshable TASKs fail-closed.
PRIMARY synchronization retains its prior strict behavior, while read-only state and non-PRIMARY command paths remain outside the new CONTINUE-only pre-observation behavior.

Deterministic regressions cover malformed and older valid stale TASKs, synchronized restart ordering, equal state, and non-behind preservation; README documents the automatic safe refresh and explicit-resolution cases.
